reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed is 30 individual foil sachets, which look wasteful, and my weekly pill organizer wouldn't even take them. A brand with zero reviews also fails my rule: I read the 1-star reviews first and want hundreds before I buy.
objection: No reviews at all, so I can't check complaints about pill size, stomach upset or fake dosing. A QR code is the brand's own claim, not other buyers telling me what happened. And a foil packet for every single serving is a lot of trash.
would_change_my_mind: Several hundred verified reviews with few complaints about stomach or capsule size, plus a regular bottle or refill pouch option that fits my pill organizer.
